repo.name: typescript-eslint
repo.description: :sparkles: Monorepo for all the tooling which enables ESLint to support TypeScript

readme.summary: This is a monorepo README that provides no package-specific documentation and only links to external documentation sites.
readme.top_issue: README contains zero installation instructions, usage examples, or configuration guidance - it's purely a meta-document about the monorepo with external links

common_complaints: Rule false positives and edge cases (no-unsafe-type-assertion stack overflow, strict-boolean-expressions with nullable strings, no-invalid-void-type with Promise.withResolvers)
Recommended rules not reflecting best practices (require-await being overly strict)
Documentation inconsistencies (yarn vs pnpm in local development setup)
praise_themes: Active community engagement with 'accepting prs' labels indicating openness to contributions
Well-organized issue triage with appropriate labeling system
Recent activity shows project is actively maintained
sentiment.summary: typescript-eslint is actively maintained with responsive triaging and community-friendly labels, but recent issues reveal frustration with rule false positives and some disconnect between recommended presets and actual best practices.
